name: consilium-spine-tests
description: Dev-only deps for the JS gates. Nothing here is deployed: Railway runs microservice/ (Python), n8n runs the workflow JSON.

scripts.test: node tests/test_syntax.js && node tests/test_undef.js && node tests/test_render_tables.js && node tests/test_number_audit.js

comment_eslint_pin: PINNED TO 8, deliberately. tests/test_undef.js drives new Linter().verify(src, {parserOptions, env, globals, rules}) — the eslint 8 API. eslint 9 moved to flat config and that call shape stops resolving identifiers. ^8 is safe; ^9 would silently turn the no-undef gate into a no-op, which is the exact failure this file exists to prevent.
